queries:
SELECT c.name
FROM constructors c
LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
GROUP BY c.constructorId
ORDER BY COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructorStandings) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM constructors) DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS standings_count,
       (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY constructorId)) AS avg_standings_count
FROM constructors c
LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name;
SELECT c.name
FROM constructorStandings cs
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY cs.constructorId
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT cs.raceId) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.name
FROM constructorStandings cs
JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.constructorId
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT r.year) DESC
LIMIT 1;
WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.name, SUM(r.points) AS total_points
  FROM results r
  JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = r.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name
)
SELECT name, ABS(total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM totals)) AS difference
FROM totals
ORDER BY difference DESC;
